title: School Today
subtitle: Modern Education for Modern Minds
description: Today, Shree Saraswati Secondary School is a vibrant and thriving educational community with two branches: the General Branch in Johang and the Technical Branch in Bidauri. With experienced teachers, modern classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a variety of co-curricular activities, the school provides an environment where students can learn, grow, and explore their full potential. We take pride in fostering academic excellence while encouraging creativity, critical thinking, and strong moral values. From its modest beginnings, the school has grown into a place where every student is supported, inspired, and prepared for the challenges of the future
